Slop Resize · Beta

Image and video resizer

Resize pictures and videos to a size, a percentage or a file limit. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Nothing to install: just open it in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. It keeps working without internet after your first visit. Want an icon on your home screen? On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. On a computer, click the install icon in the address bar.

Slop Resize has these main features: Presets for social, email and 4K sizes; Fit, cover, stretch and fit-inside, with an anchor. It opens Any image, Video.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Slop Resize

  • Resize many images at once
  • Compress an image to 100 KB or less
  • Resize a video to 1080p, 720p or any size
  • Scale up pixel art without blurring it
  • Resize RAW photos in bulk
